status: pre_norm — items are original and unvalidated; report as reflective insights until pilot data establishes reliability

G11_CONFIRMATION.rule: Re-administer the IDENTICAL scored items so G9->G11 deltas are comparable. Never edit an item's wording without bumping the version and flagging affected deltas.

items.text: I get curious about how things work and go looking for answers.
I enjoy ideas that most people my age find boring.
I like trying new ways of doing things, even when the old way works.
I daydream about inventing, designing or creating something.
I prefer to stick to what I already know rather than try something unfamiliar.
Talking about big questions, like why people do what they do, bores me.
When I start something, I finish it.
I plan my homework or tasks before I start.
I keep my things organised so I can find them.
I do what I said I would do, even when nobody is checking.
I leave schoolwork until the last minute.
I get distracted easily and lose track of what I was doing.
Being around lots of people gives me energy.
I am comfortable speaking up in front of the class.
I am usually the one who starts conversations.
I enjoy being the centre of attention sometimes.
After a busy day with people, I need time alone to recharge.
I would rather work quietly on my own than in a busy group.
I notice when someone is left out and try to include them.
I would rather find a solution everyone agrees with than win an argument.
I trust people until they give me a reason not to.
I go out of my way to help classmates who are struggling.
I can be harsh with people when I am annoyed.
Other people's problems are not really my business.
I worry a lot about things that might go wrong.
My mood can change quickly during the day.
Tests and deadlines make me very anxious.
Small criticism can stay with me for days.
I stay calm when things go wrong.
I bounce back quickly after a bad day.

scales.name: Builder
scales.stem: How much would you enjoy doing this?

items.text: Fixing a broken bicycle, appliance or phone.
Building something with tools or your hands.
Working outdoors with plants, animals or the land.
Operating machines or driving vehicles.
Assembling furniture or electronics from instructions.
Repairing things around the house.

scales.name: Thinker
scales.stem: How much would you enjoy doing this?

items.text: Doing a science experiment to test an idea.
Figuring out why a disease spreads.
Solving a hard maths or logic puzzle.
Researching how the brain or body works.
Analysing data to find a pattern.
Investigating why something went wrong.

scales.name: Creator
scales.stem: How much would you enjoy doing this?

items.text: Writing a song, poem, story or rap.
Designing clothes, a logo or a poster.
Acting, dancing or performing on stage.
Drawing, painting or making digital art.
Filming or editing a video.
Coming up with a completely original idea for a project.

scales.name: Helper
scales.stem: How much would you enjoy doing this?

items.text: Helping a younger learner understand their homework.
Listening to a friend and helping them through a hard time.
Caring for people who are sick or injured.
Organising a community clean-up or charity drive.
Teaching a skill to a group of people.
Coaching a sports team or club.

scales.name: Leader
scales.stem: How much would you enjoy doing this?

items.text: Starting your own small business.
Convincing people to support your idea.
Leading a team to win a competition.
Selling something and making a profit.
Running for class representative or learner council.
Negotiating a deal.

scales.name: Organiser
scales.stem: How much would you enjoy doing this?

items.text: Keeping track of money and budgets.
Organising files, records or a schedule.
Checking work carefully for mistakes.
Working with spreadsheets and numbers.
Following a clear system or procedure.
Planning an event step by step.

scales.name: What Matters Most
scales.instructions: Drag the 3 cards that matter MOST to you into order (1 = most). Then pick the 2 that matter LEAST.

cards.text: Freedom to choose my own path
Safety and stability for me and my family
Doing what is expected and fitting in
Respecting my family, faith and culture
Looking after the people close to me
Fairness and a better world for everyone

scales.name: Why I Do Schoolwork
scales.construct: Self-Determination Theory regulation types (Relative Autonomy Index)
scales.stem: When I do my schoolwork, I do it...

items.text: Because I enjoy learning new things.
Because some of it is genuinely interesting to me.
Because it matters for the future I want.
Because I can see why it is important.
Because I would feel guilty or ashamed if I didn't.
Because I want people to think I am clever.
Because I will get into trouble if I don't.
Because adults expect me to and I have no choice.

scales.name: Growth Mindset
scales.construct: Implicit theories of intelligence (growth vs fixed)

items.text: If I work hard enough, I can get better at any subject.
Mistakes show me what I need to practise.
Struggling with something means my brain is learning.
Some people are just born good at maths and others are not.
If I have to try hard at something, I am probably not good at it.
My intelligence is something I cannot really change.

scales.name: Where I Am With My Future

items.text: I have spent time looking into different careers I might like.
I have talked to adults about what their jobs are actually like.
I have thought seriously about which subjects suit me, not just which ones my friends are taking.
I have tried activities outside school to find out what I am good at.
I have questioned whether the plan other people have for me fits who I am.
I know what kind of work I want to do one day.
I feel sure about the direction I am heading.
My plans for the future feel like they belong to me.
If someone asked, I could explain why I want the career I want.
I have no idea what I want to do after school.
My career plan mostly comes from what my parents or family want for me.
I am choosing subjects mainly because my friends are taking them.
I am choosing based on what sounds impressive or pays well, not what I enjoy.
I have a regular time and place to study.
When I don't understand something, I ask a teacher or classmate.
I test myself instead of just reading over my notes.
I keep going with hard work instead of giving up.
I know which subjects I need to spend more time on.
I only study the night before a test.
I avoid asking for help even when I am stuck.
My phone distracts me most of the time when I study.

scales.name: My Study Situation
scales.construct: Practical barriers (not scored into any profile; used only for support planning)

items.text: Do you have a quiet place to study at home?
Do you have enough data or internet access for schoolwork?
Do responsibilities at home (like caring for siblings or working) take up a lot of your study time?

attention_checks.text: To show you are reading carefully, choose 'Mostly like me' for this one.
Choose 'Dislike' for this one so we know you are still with us.

SUBJECT_EXPERIENCE.applies_to: each FET subject the learner takes (excluding Life Orientation)

items.text: I look forward to this subject.
I feel energised, not drained, after this subject.
I would choose this subject again if I could start Grade 10 over.
This subject connects to the future I want.
I understand the work when it is explained to me.
I feel I can get better at this subject.

FAILURE_CAUSE.applies_to: only subjects where the latest mark is below 50%
FAILURE_CAUSE.stem: Think about this subject. How true is each of these?

items.text: I fell behind in an earlier grade and never caught up.
I don't study this subject regularly, only before tests.
The way this subject is taught at my school does not work for me.
Things at home make it hard to study for this subject.
I honestly don't care about this subject.
I feel too stressed or tired to focus on this subject.

CAREER_UPDATE.text: What career or field are you leaning towards right now? (It's fine to say 'not sure'.)
Compared to Grade 9, your direction is...
What have you done to explore careers since Grade 9?
options: Spoke to someone in a job I'm interested in
